title: Luxury City Retreat-Close To Downtown
description:
Spacious and stunning upscale townhouse, just under 3 miles from the vibrant center of Music City and easily accessible to all local destinations via a quick Uber ride. This unit boasts 7 beds, ideal for accommodating large groups comfortably. The main level showcases a fantastic kitchen with generous seating, top-of-the-line appliances, a sleek bar-style counter, and contemporary furnishings. Additionally, one garage space is available for your convenience.

The space
The house is multiple levels with superb finishes and tons of space for large groups and families. It has multiple beds ranging from a comfy king all the way to the cozy double bunks. The home also features 3.5 bathrooms, a laundry area with washer/dryer, comfortable sitting areas, and more. Each bedroom features ultra-comfy beds and storage for personal items.

The kitchen area has a fantastic bar seating area for entertaining, all updated appliances, and is fully stocked with cooking supplies, dishes, glassware, a coffee maker, and more. The living room is decorated with a contemporary mindset accompanied by a floating flat screen and cozy gray sofa. The living area was designed to maximize the feel of comfort and space, delivering a perfectly relaxing atmosphere.

★ Modern Kitchen with Great Appliances
★ Hottest Area in Nashville
★ High-Speed Wifi
★ Big Groups Welcome

★ Bedroom 1 - King Bed

★ Bedroom 2 - 2 Twins over Twin Bunk Beds

★ Bedroom 3 - 2 Queen Beds

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!
